provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the nightshades work (2026-10-17): every character from the floras in the nightshades notes (plantgen-claude project-files/nightshades/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Fuchsia excorticata, plant_name_id 2814892 (Library 1.0 list, read 2026-10-17).

growth_form.note: Its habit as the floras describe it, drawn by the decurrent_tree form.

growth.note: Grown to the age it is drawn at: an annual's one season, a perennial's or shrub's few years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: Cheeseman, Manual of the New Zealand Flora, 2nd ed. (1925), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 618 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a shrub or small tree 10-40 ft; Hooker (p. 75): 10-30 ft. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 7.5 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.life_span.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a small tree, the largest of the genus.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Cheeseman, Manual of the New Zealand Flora, 2nd ed. (1925), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 618 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a shrub or small tree 10-40 ft; Hooker (p. 75): 10-30 ft.

traits.height_max_m.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 55 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a small tree 45 ft high; Wikipedia 'Fuchsia excorticata': to 13 m.

traits.stem_diameter_max_m.note: Cheeseman, Manual of the New Zealand Flora, 2nd ed. (1925), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 618 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): trunk usually 6-18 in diam., sometimes 2-3 ft; Kirk (p. 53): short, often gnarled, 1-3 ft.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Cheeseman, Manual of the New Zealand Flora, 2nd ed. (1925), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 618 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves deciduous; Wikipedia: deciduous in most of the South Island, leafless May to August.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves alternate; Kirk (p. 53), Cheeseman (p. 618) and Bailey (vol. 3 p. 1303) the same.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, usually narrowed into long straight points.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): acuminate, narrowed into long straight points.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Cheeseman, Manual of the New Zealand Flora, 2nd ed. (1925), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 618 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): entire or obscurely and remotely toothed; Kirk (p. 55): minute distant serratures.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 1.5-4 in; Hooker (p. 75): 1.5-3.5 in; Wikipedia: to 10 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the leaves twice as long as their slender petioles: half the blade's 1.5-3.5 in.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): green above, silvery below; Wikipedia: medium to dark green above. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.bark_texture.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): thin bark of a bright reddish-brown hue, which on old specimens divides into numerous paper-like flakes; Hooker (p. 75): ragged, papery bark.

traits.bark_colour.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): bright reddish-brown; Wikipedia: copper, orange to reddish-brown. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.bark_inner_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): peels to show the smooth pale-green cambial layer beneath; photograph iNaturalist 114805150. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Across its reflexed sepals, which no source measures: two narrow sepals of about 8 mm (Wikipedia 'Fuchsia excorticata') bent back from a tube mouth a few millimetres wide; the flower is 19-32 mm long (Hooker p. 75; Cheeseman p. 618)

traits.hypanthium_length_m.note: The floral tube, which no source measures alone: the flower's 19-32 mm (Cheeseman p. 618; Hooker p. 75) less its sepals; globular above the ovary, then contracted and lengthened into a funnel (Hooker p. 75)

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): sepals 8 mm long, 3 mm wide at the base, narrow-triangular; Hooker (p. 75): lanceolate, very acuminate.

traits.sepal_posture.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 55 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): sepals reflexed or recurved; p. 53: ultimately curved backwards.

traits.calyx_colour.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 53 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): at first greenish, streaked or blotched with a dull deep purple, passing at length into a dull red; Wikipedia: lustrous green sepals. The colour is our reading of the words, its first green.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): petals dark purple, 1.8-5 mm; Kirk (p. 53): minute.

traits.flower_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): petals dark purple; Kirk (p. 53): at first black, then bright purple. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.stamen_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): filaments purple to pale cream, 6-15 mm and 5-10 mm; Cheeseman (p. 618): very variable, the flowers trimorphic.

traits.filament_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): filaments purple to pale cream, anthers purple; Kirk (p. 54): the pollen a beautiful mazarin blue. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.style_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): style green to yellow, 22-40 mm; Cheeseman (p. 618): in the long-styled form twice the calyx tube.

traits.flowering_months.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 55 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): August to December; Cheeseman (p. 618) and Wikipedia the same.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Fuchsia excorticata' (read 2026-10-17): 9-13 mm long; Cheeseman (p. 618): oblong, 1/2 in long.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Cheeseman, Manual of the New Zealand Flora, 2nd ed. (1925), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 618 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): purplish-black, juicy; Kirk (p. 53): blackish-brown or black. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: berries ripening from November to February, after the August-December flowers.
